title: DeskAgentEventEnvelope
description: Standard event notification envelope for Desk Agent R1

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event emission

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number scoped to sequence_scope. Gaps indicate dropped events.

sequence_scope.description: Scope identifier for the sequence number (e.g., 'device:esp32s3', 'task:tsk-1234', 'ha:event_bus')

request_id.description: Correlation request ID if this event was triggered by an explicit request

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event occurrence
